_readme: Performance directions for lines that carry no parenthetical in the script. `match` is the start (>=12 chars) or whole of the dialogue line as parsed; `tags` are Eleven v4 audio tags prefixed to the line (v4 also follows compound tags like [low, gravelly voice] and explicit [pause] / [long pause]); `text` replaces the whole line (inline tags, added pauses); `fx` = radio | offscreen | ethereal | abyss | distant. Optional `scene` or `after` (a substring of the preceding action) disambiguate a line that recurs. Stale entries are reported on every run; `s2c voices --rematch-directions preview` re-points them after a rewrite.

_note: the (beat) parenthetical is parsed as a leading '...', so the match includes it

match: Floating. Two hundred yards off the point.
text: [flat] Floating. [pause] Two hundred yards off the point.

match: Did you find the other one?
